# javap -c -p excerpts for the stick sources in packages/rotn-data/3.3.4/world-sources.json
# (deadbush-sticks; fell-tree, including its correction on leaves), from the pinned RotN 3.3.4 server pack zip
# (SHA-256 90642fd5...f5205). Extracted to a scratch folder outside the repo; nothing was run.
# Read by packages/rotn-data/test/stick-sources.test.js.
#
# Jars (SHA-256):
#   minecraft_server.1.12.2.jar                 fe1f9274e6dad9191bf6e6e8e36ee6ebc737f373603df0946aafcded0d53167e
#   libraries/.../forge-1.12.2-14.23.5.2860.jar cd3fbf85d7ca744507fd6a37a41b90122d43e616a4f8962332b1b658655e8a64
#   mods/pyrotech-1.12.2-1.5.25.jar             2b28dd9274ca66e4d981547c4cce36bc081b2bc925d694dda4249f412cdbf36a
#   mods/DramaticTrees-1.12.2-0.13.4.jar        b86dae768ccc1182c52e5b9a8756a5906da53dc125d48bfe1c8dc69204a77ffe
#   mods/athenaeum-1.12.2-1.19.6.jar            (OreDictHelper.contains: OreDictionary.getOreIDs(stack) contains the ore id)
#
# Vanilla classes are obfuscated. Forge patches some of them at load time (binpatches.pack.lzma in the
# Forge jar: LZMA, then pack200, then one GDIFF patch per class). The vanilla sections below are the
# classes AFTER applying Forge's server binpatch; each patch's input Adler-32 matched the shipped class.
# Names come from the Forge jar's deobfuscation_data-1.12.2.lzma (notch -> SRG), lines in "## SRG".
